headline: Slate Auto adds Crayola-color wraps to EV truck
summary: Slate Auto partners with Crayola for custom vehicle wraps
details: Slate Auto, an EV startup backed by Jeff Bezos, offers a $24,950 unpainted gray electric truck with 205 miles of range. The company allows buyers to customize their vehicles through wraps, decals, and accessories.
Slate Auto is partnering with Crayola to offer five vehicle wraps in signature Crayola colors, including Cerulean, Fern, Jersey Tomato, Razzmatazz, and Dandelion. These wraps cost $1,549.99.
The Crayola-color vehicle wraps come with a matching Crayola key fob and 'Slatelet,' a custom art piece that snaps onto the dashboard.
